description: This file defines the CheckBookingLimitsService class responsible for checking booking limits within a booking system, including methods for validating limits based on time intervals and handling booking count retrieval via a repository.

classes.name: CheckBookingLimitsService
classes.description: Service class for checking booking limits based on various interval constraints.

methods.name: _checkBookingLimits
methods.description: Private method that checks multiple booking limits concurrently and handles errors.

methods.name: checkBookingLimits
methods.description: Public method wrapped with reporting, triggers the limit checks.

methods.name: _checkBookingLimit
methods.description: Private method that checks individual booking limit for a specific interval and throws error if limit exceeded.

methods.name: checkBookingLimit
